hourly.summary: Arsenal fans are reeling from the men's team's humiliating Carabao Cup exit to League Two Fleetwood Town — a proper 'cupset' that's sparked ridicule from rivals and soul-searching about penalty-taking 'dances'. The women's team provided the only cheer with a dominant 3-0 UWCL win over Benfica as Alessia Russo became the competition's all-time top English scorer with a hat-trick. Forum regulars are distracting themselves with all-time striker rankings (Henry top, Sanogo bottom) and debating whether Nketiah-to-Gyokeres was a downgrade.

daily.summary: Arsenal fan sentiment plummeted across the day: starting with mixed frustration over Ballon d'Or snubs (6/10), deepening into aggrieved entitlement (4/10), briefly lifting to cautious optimism around youth prospects and cup momentum (7/10), before collapsing into full-blown crisis after a humiliating 1-1 draw against League Two Fleetwood Town, a red card for a 16-year-old, and a penalty shootout scrape (2/10). The day's arc traces a sharp emotional nosedive from wounded pride to outright embarrassment.

weekly.summary: Arsenal fan sentiment traced a sharp V-shape across the week: starting defiant but quickly descending into anxious guardedness after a Champions League draw at Bayern and Bukayo Saka's long-term injury confirmation, before rocketing to buoyant euphoria following a routine win over Everton and simultaneous slips from title rivals. The mid-week panic over Saka's absence and transfer frustration gave way to a weekend surge of title-race belief, Ben White praise, and schadenfreude, leaving the fanbase convinced a genuine charge is underway despite the looming Anfield test.
